This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Who Else Knows?" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their bumpy [[Color|brown]] skin, white [[hair]], single large [[eye]] with bright blue irises, and small spikes extending from their cheeks.<ref name="Who Else Knows?" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[1 BBY]], a member of this species could be found in the [[Tomkip Towers]] apartment buildings, encountering an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[ISB tactical agent|ISB tactical team]] who was sweeping the area in search of [[Kleya Marki]].<ref name="Who Else Knows?" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Who Else Knows?|eleventh episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']],<ref name="Who Else Knows?" /> directed by [[Alonso Ruizpalacios]] and aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> Their head was built and puppeteered by [[Matt Hart]], referred to by the nickname "Cyclops" on the set of Andor Season 2, and performed by [[Cavin Cornwall]].<ref name="Puppeteer">{{Instagram|username=matt.hart87|url=p/DJpk-MctJ4c|name=[[Matt Hart]]|date=2025-05-14|quote=Well, the wait was worth it, what a great show and a pleasure to work on.
I feel like the majority of my work on this was on set, but managed to build a few heads too, which all appeared! I even got my first puppeteer credit for the Cyclops I built!! (Despite also puppeteering a senator earlier in the series...) In 2023, I also had a great trip with the CFX team to Valencia to shoot a load of great content at the impressive Museo de las Ciencias Príncipe Felipe. 1. Cyclops - I meched and puppeteered, performed by the amazing @cavincornwall 2. Boris - I meched and was performed by the amazing @lauren97king and puppeteered on set by the equally amazing @claireroiharvey. This guy should have had more screen time! 3. 'Elvis' the dog - I meched the head and @ashflash_26 meched the body, was a rushed build and looked great when we finished it. Shout-out to @cerinaknott for the late night we all did to get it over the line. Performed by the brilliant @wimoppenheimer and @neilsterenbergpuppeteer On to the next job with a bunch of incredible people 🤘|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/qKe9G}}</ref>
